The drop in blobs included however looks higher than it should, ill see if i can get a better metric on it. We have a few blobs metrics for sure. We have to add it to our grafana 🙂 oh unfortunately, looks like something we should investigate I restarted it - not helped, removed blob db - not helped. Looking in the logs and looks like we are not receiving any payloads restarted prysm? that usually triggers the fcus to be sent again. but you should also check the snooper if there was an `invalid` returned at some point, that could set the CL down on the wrong path.
